issue.title: Finish capture lists — section names with spaces, header completion, and undoable ID splices
issue.description: A list header can name any section, including one whose title has spaces (`@sase#future-work` or `@sase#"Future Work"` both reach `## Future Work`). Picking a section from the menu always inserts a selector that reaches that section. Route and section completion work on a list header even after bullets are typed below it. Accepting a block ID in Bob Mac Capture is one native Undo step. With this done, bob-cli-fn can land.

payload.entry: LAND AUDIT / FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: Read fn.5 and both children with every note, parent fn decisions/landing notes, approved plan, bob-cli b483c93b and Mac f4ed5bb source/tests. Neither fn.5.1 nor fn.5.2 has a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entry. fn.5.1 #1 is implemented for ordinary spaced selectors/header completion/incomplete literals/off-clock equivalence; #2 stale keep_moving golden is fixed. fn.5.2 #1/#2 test harness fixes are in f4ed5bb; #3/#4 report all seven new Undo tests passing on CI 41466582525, with 21 existing failures owned by f3/fu (both beads read); no new independent defect or new task proposal. Remaining epic defect: section_selector_replacement checks raw spelling safety only on title, not slug. Heading including literal quotes, e.g. ## "Future Work", yields slug "future-work"; resolver-only check succeeds but parse_route_token decodes it as exact future-work, so completion cannot reach the selected heading. Curly opening quotes have the same problem. Exact fallback is also not checked against heading identity, so duplicate titles can produce a candidate for a heading the selector cannot reach. These violate phase-1 round-trip scope and stay epic work, to be repaired by one tale, not a task bead. Preserve all inherited DECISIONS and ID calibration. No proposals declined beyond the parent fn notes #2/#3/#8 already-recorded triage. epic-symbols fn.5 is currently clean; no symvision recipe.
